text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Satono Diamond—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Satono Diamond 
was gazing, I saw a claw machine filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no mistake. That is our 
affiliate company's new arcade cabinet!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I heard they'd be hitting the market soon, 
but they're finally making their debut...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer! If you'd like, would you like 
to play it and give it a try!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching over it ever since it 
was in development, and I just had to see 
the moment people finally got to play it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you catch a whole bunch, um— I'd like 
to present you with a special prize from 
myself as well! How does that sound...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
